test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The young man agreed _______ the proposal of the officer.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**agreed**" is typically followed by the preposition "**to**" when referring to accepting or consenting to a proposal, idea, or request.
 
• Other prepositions such as "**on**," "**with**," and "**in**" do not fit the context of this sentence.
